Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1795143. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an inner join to require canonical SMILES. Filter by target ChEMBL ID, standard type IC50, exact standard relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Order results by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
